summary: Something can feel beautiful, meaningful, and completely right while you are still filling in half the story yourself.
body: Something can feel beautiful, meaningful, and completely right while you are still filling in half the story yourself. When Venus conjuncts Neptune, attraction, hope, creativity, and idealization can blur together, making a person, offer, purchase, or relationship feel more complete than the facts currently make it. You do not need to ruin the feeling by interrogating it, but you do need to notice what you actually know and what you have lovingly supplied on its behalf. Let the beauty be real without requiring the fantasy to become a contract.
